article: HTMLでプレゼン資料を作る方法（reveal.js）
scope: Read the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations. Compared meaning, localized terminology, code, commands, links, metadata, and current claims against official reveal.js documentation.
findings: Clarified that the official Basic Setup ZIP workflow remains supported and that Full Setup provides the local development server/tooling.
Added verified slide hierarchy, fragments, inline Markdown, external Markdown server requirement, local Full Setup commands, PDF printing steps, and speaker notes/view workflow.
Removed third-party Qiita references in favor of six official guides; added a reminder to review media rights and sensitive notes.
Restored the original 2023-04-06 publication date from Git history and set lastmod to 2026-11-23 across all editions.
